onboarding.agreement.text:
User Agreement & Disclaimer

1. Service Description
This application is a mod loading and management tool designed for Terraria, using process injection technology to implement Mod balancing mechanisms. This application is fully open-source and follows the AGPL-3.0 license.

2. Open Source Statement
• This product and all its built-in components are fully open-source, with source code publicly available for review.
• This software is licensed under the AGPL-3.0 license. You have the right to copy, modify, and distribute this software.
• Any derivative works based on this software must also be released under the AGPL-3.0 license as open source.

3. Multiplayer Isolation Guarantee
• This application implements multiplayer environment isolation from the original Terraria client.
• All mod loading is performed in an isolated environment and does not modify or affect the original Terraria game files.
• This application does not cause any damage to the original Terraria game environment.
• Players using mods are in a different multiplayer partition from vanilla players, ensuring no interference between them.

4. Platform Compatibility
• This application supports the following platforms: Android, Linux, Windows, macOS.
• All platform versions have consistent functionality and comply with all terms of this agreement.
• Users must assess the risks of use themselves regarding compatibility issues caused by system differences across platforms.

5. User Responsibility & Risk Acknowledgment
• Users assume all risks associated with using this service.
• Issues such as Terraria mod loss, save corruption, game crashes, etc., resulting from the use of injection technology operations are the sole responsibility of the user, and we assume no liability.
• Users must ensure their use of this service complies with applicable laws and regulations.
• Users are solely responsible for all legal liability arising from their use of this service.
• Using non-official mods with this application may affect the game experience. Users are responsible for vetting mod sources.

6. Disclaimer
• This service is provided 'as is' without any express or implied warranties.
• We are not responsible for any direct or indirect losses (including but not limited to mod loss, game crashes, device damage, save corruption) arising from the use of this service.
• Users assume all risks of any device or software issues resulting from the use of this service.
• This application provides only a technical tool; users must independently decide whether to use it.

7. Legal Compliance Notice
• This application is for study and research purposes only. Users must not use it for any illegal or infringing activities.
• Since this application is fully open-source, any individual or organization can review the code to ensure security and compliance.
• Issues such as Terraria game account penalties or bans resulting from improper use of this application are unrelated to this application.
• Terraria is a registered trademark of Re-Logic. This application is not officially endorsed by Re-Logic and is a third-party community tool.

8. Intellectual Property
• The source code, design, and content of this application are protected by intellectual property laws but are subject to the AGPL-3.0 open-source license.
• Under the terms of the AGPL-3.0 license, you are free to use, modify, and distribute this software.
• Terraria-related copyrights belong to Re-Logic. This application only provides technical compatibility.

9. Agreement Modifications
• We reserve the right to modify this agreement at any time.
• Modified agreements will be posted on this page. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the modifications.

10. Agreement Validity
• This agreement constitutes the complete legal agreement between you and us.
• If any provision of this agreement is deemed invalid, the remaining provisions shall remain in effect.
onboarding.android.tips1: Requires patching an unencrypted game, or granting Root permissions and activating the Xposed Framework for normal operation.
onboarding.android.tips2: If Root mode crashes, enable 'Restore Inline Hooks' for Terraria in the Xposed Framework.
onboarding.android.tips3: If External mode crashes, try using a different game installation package and re-patch/reinstall.
onboarding.android.tips4: External mode requires the manager to remain running in the background. Do not close the app, or mods may fail to load.
onboarding.desktop.tips1: Windows users must use the x32 version. To use the x64 version, you need to download the TEFKernel source code, modify it, and recompile it.
onboarding.desktop.tips2: tefloader does not inject directly into the game assembly. The vanilla game can be launched via file or Steam.
onboarding.desktop.tips3: Using unofficial clients may require a custom tefloader.
